rollforward.notes: Guard A(45,264)+B(94,419)-P(121,121)=18,562 vs E=15,562 -> off by exactly 3,000 ($'000). NOT a mis-read: B is the before-retention for-year subtotal per task spec (total return 95,041 - distribution adjustments 624 + rollover 2 = 94,419; this is a derived component, not a single printed line). The printed identity that closes uses the AFTER-retention 'Income for the year available for distribution' = 91,419: 45,264 + 91,419 - 121,121 = 15,562 (exact). The 3,000 gap = the disclosed 'Amount retained for capital expenditure' line (S$3.0m/yr retained since FY12 per AR footnote). No number plugged; the cumulative-trap line 'Amount available for distribution to Unitholders' = 136,683 was deliberately NOT used as B. P=121,121 is cash paid during the year (mixes the FY2023 final 7.48c tranche 45,254 and excludes the FY2024 final 2.38c not yet paid), distinct from the DPU-14.92c declared-for-year (income for the year available 91,419). Distribution Statement on printed pp.125-126 (PDF markers PAGE 64 main statement / PAGE 65 Notes A & B).
